list.name: Site
list.label: Site
list.query:
SELECT __text, __value FROM (
    SELECT 0 AS sort_order, '— All sites —' AS __text, '' AS __value
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 1, site_name, site_id::text
    FROM analytics.v_grafana_sites
    WHERE grafana_org_id = ${__org.id}
) ranked
ORDER BY sort_order, __text

    SELECT 0 AS sort_order, '— All locations —' AS __text, '' AS __value
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DISTINCT 1, location_path, location_key
    FROM analytics.v_grafana_asset_selector
    WHERE grafana_org_id = ${__org.id}
      AND ('${Site:raw}' = '' OR site_id::text = '${Site:raw}')
) ranked
ORDER BY sort_order, __text

panels.title: Analytics Explorer (max 5 assets X 5 metrics)
panels.description: Routed through analytics.get_grafana_explorer_intervals: native samples for <=24h ranges, 15-minute rollups for <=14d, hourly rollups beyond that. Hard-capped at 5 assets and 5 metrics -- the Asset/Metric arrays are CASE-guarded below so a >5 selection returns zero rows instead of reaching the database's own hard exception. There is no separate status banner: exceeding the limit currently renders as a silently empty chart with no on-screen explanation.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selection AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN array_length(NULLIF(ARRAY[${Asset:singlequote}]::uuid[], ARRAY[NULL::uuid]), 1) <= 5
            THEN ARRAY[${Asset:singlequote}]::uuid[]
            ELSE ARRAY[]::uuid[]
        END AS asset_ids,
        CASE
            WHEN array_length(NULLIF(ARRAY[${Metric:singlequote}]::text[], ARRAY[NULL::text]), 1) <= 5
            THEN ARRAY[${Metric:singlequote}]::text[]
            ELSE ARRAY[]::text[]
        END AS logical_points
),

raw_data AS (
    SELECT
        x.interval_start,
        COALESCE(sel_a.asset_name, x.asset_id::text) AS asset_name,
        COALESCE(sel_p.logical_point, x.logical_point_id::text) AS logical_point_name,
        x.avg_value,
        x.max_value

    FROM selection

    CROSS JOIN LATERAL analytics.get_grafana_explorer_intervals(
        ${__org.id}::bigint,
        selection.asset_ids,
        selection.logical_points,
        $__timeFrom()::timestamptz,
        $__timeTo()::timestamptz
    ) AS x

    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT asset_name
        FROM analytics.v_grafana_asset_selector
        WHERE asset_id = x.asset_id
          AND grafana_org_id = ${__org.id}
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS sel_a ON TRUE

    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT logical_point
        FROM analytics.v_grafana_asset_point_selector
        WHERE logical_point_id = x.logical_point_id
          AND grafana_org_id = ${__org.id}
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS sel_p ON TRUE
)

SELECT
    interval_start AS time,

    CASE
        WHEN logical_point_name ILIKE '%ENERGY%' THEN
            GREATEST(
                0,
                max_value - LAG(max_value) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY asset_name, logical_point_name
                    ORDER BY interval_start
                )
            )
        ELSE avg_value
    END AS value,

    asset_name || ' - ' || logical_point_name AS metric

FROM raw_data

ORDER BY interval_start
